prince.title: 想看清自己時，籠統承認「我有盲點」與對到某處盲點差在哪裏
prince.notes:
【總編再輕修｜同輪】限度段「他人證詞…且可被惡德污染」改為「創傷或突破經驗…不保證」（對上已並排 SERC；刪未核證詞／污染句）。

【首輪｜round=1｜2026-11-01｜pass｜兩欄已齊即審】總編輕微改：①正文第15段同註腳2刪「證詞途徑亦可／可被惡德污染」（本機 SERC 2015／書章公開摘要未見對應連續句；gate 允許刪未核前提）；②「清晰」改「警覺」以對上 SERC 有寫之 alertness；③註腳2補標核實層（SERC＋書章摘要；完整 2019 書 PDF 未另下）。結構同署名保留，唔代筆重寫。跟 geo-gate 至【過關補充｜2026-10-28】。本 notes 寫「已跟」前已對禁止做法逐項交代，唔只打勾日期標題。

【命題｜S4】跟 W44 proposition「想看清自己時，甚麼才算對到盲點，而不只是換了一套更順口的自我說法？」；theme=哲學，對 angles.哲學。第9段換切「籠統承認『我有盲點／我很謙虛／我知自己有局限』」對「對到某處具體盲點（講得出改了哪一處判斷、可否再被挑戰）」；第19段發現：全域／姿態式承認可以只是更順口的自我說法；對到仍要講得出改了哪一處判斷、可否再被挑戰。照顧蛇質問：對到唔預設事先一定有盲點；更順口唔必然未對到；唔只鎖主動內省；唔把對到收窄成只聽外力（第21段）。文章可反駁命題；本日係收窄機制切面，唔當不過。angle 只作鏡頭。

【定義／關鍵詞｜10-07／10-08】第11段定「籠統承認／姿態式謙遜自述」「對到盲點」「智識局限的擁有（owning）」「隱蔽惡德（stealthy vices）」；其後沿同一組意思用，冇把「籠統承認」偷換成「已對到」，亦冇把「對到」偷換成「事先必有盲點」或「凡自述謙遜皆假」。核心詞（籠統承認／姿態式／擁有／隱蔽惡德／對到盲點／判斷改動／可否再被挑戰／更順口）逐個查過轉義。完整詞「判斷」「批判」屬允許；禁作動詞嘅單獨「判」搜過正文＋註腳冇中。

【讓步有冇照顧結論｜10-05／10-06｜憑段】第21段三限度：（1）三源讀成日常「想看清自己」＝推論；（2）對到唔預設事先有盲點、更順口唔必然未對到；否定嘅係把姿態式全域自述本身當成對到憑證，唔否定籠統承認同時改到可被挑戰判斷；（3）主題卡唔把對到收窄成只聽外力；卡薩姆指出創傷／突破有時可開眼，只是不保證。三點合起來收到第19段發現，有照顧結論。第13／15／17段各標「這是我的推論」／「這同樣是推論」。

【禁用語｜正文＋註腳】硬規則禁用語、企業腔例詞、口號式收尾、style 列出嘅抽象指令、無出處「常見／一般都」——rg 掃過正文＋註腳冇中。第9段自限「不重寫那幾劃」係跟主題卡鏡頭，唔係有步驟練習。

【教材】冇有步驟練習。專欄問一個問題收尾；唔對讀者落指令。字數：正文 CJK 約 2199（±200 內）。

【S6／過關補充逐項｜核實層分開｜10-11至10-28｜框架同操作分開｜否定／肯定半句各自並排｜自標同並排分開計】

核實層說明：Whitcomb et al. 2017＝已核本機 PDF／txt（/workspace/factcheck-2026-11-01/whitcomb-2017.pdf｜.txt）；Cassam stealthy vices＝已並排公開 SERC 2015 PDF（同目錄 cassam-stealthy-real.pdf；完整 2019 書未另下——書層細節標二手／摘要）；Tanesini 2021＝已並排公開 Precis／二次摘要句（完整書 PDF 未另下）；唔把段意報入「各自有原句」。

1. Whitcomb et al. 2017（第13段＋註腳1）——【框架截·肯定】(A) 智識謙遜＝對自己智識局限的恰當態度＝恰當留意＋擁有；(B) 恰當留意在傲慢（局限不上雷達）與奴性（只看得見局限）之間的中道，場合要求時局限才上雷達；(C) 擁有涵蓋認知／行為／動機／情感等傾向。【否定半句自標】(D) 「凡說自己有局限都是假謙遜」＝作者自標「會超過原文」，唔報入並排；(E) 「口頭籠統說≠場合要求時對某處具體局限做 owning」＝作者推論收窄。【自標】(F) 讀成日常想看清＝作者推論。並排 PDF／txt 原句：\"Intellectual humility, then, is having the right stance toward one's intellectual limitations\"／\"Appropriate attentiveness… disposition to be aware… of one's limitations, for them to come to mind when the occasion calls for it\"／\"the paradigmatically arrogant person… don't show up on his radar\"／\"The paradigmatically servile person… radar is perpetually peppered with his limitations\"／\"humility lies in the mean between these extremes. When life calls for one to be mindful of a limitation, then, and only then, will it appear on the ideally humble person's radar\"／\"owning an intellectual limitation consists in a dispositional profile that includes cognitive, behavioral, motivational, and affective responses\"／\"disposed to believe and accept that she has the limitations that she does\"／\"admit their limitations to others, avoid pretense\"／\"disposed to care about them and take them seriously\"／\"disposed to regret, but not be hostile about, her limitations\"／\"laughs it off as a cute quirk\". 並排範圍＝A–C；D–F 自標／推論分開計。

2. Cassam（第15段＋註腳2）——核實層＝已並排 SERC 2015；2019 書 obstructivist 定義另並排公開書評 Beatson et al. 2019 引 Cassam 原句；完整書未另下。【框架截·肯定】(A) 認識論惡德系統阻礙獲取／保存／分享知識；(B) 隱蔽惡德本質上難被主動批判反思偵測，因其抵消／否定主動批判反思所依賴的德性；閉心比粗心更隱蔽；(C) 創傷／突破經驗有時可開眼，但不保證。【否定半句自標】(D) 「凡自認謙虛都是閉心／凡對到只能聽外力」＝作者自標超過原文；(E) 籠統自認可與 stealthy vice 並存＝作者推論。並排 SERC 原句：\"some intellectual vices are stealthier than others: by their nature they evade detection by those who have them\"／\"Being careless needn't prevent you from gathering evidence of your carelessness… In contrast… being closed-minded is likely to stand in the way of knowing that you are closed-minded\"／\"closed-mindedness is bound to be, to some extent at least, self-concealing\"／\"antithetical to the one of intellectual virtues that is needed to detect one's intellectual vices by conscious critical reflection\"／\"A degree of open-mindedness is one pre-requisite. Another is alertness\"／\"willingness to acknowledge… implies a significant degree of intellectual humility\"／\"coming into focus as a result of a tragic event or traumatic personal experience\"／\"To say that this can happen is not to say that it is likely to happen\". 並排書評引 obstructivist：\"an epistemic vice is a ‘blameworthy or otherwise reprehensible character trait, attitude, or way of thinking that systematically obstructs the gaining, keeping, or sharing of knowledge’ (23)\". 並排範圍＝A–C；D–E 自標分開。書末自我改善樂觀句只核到註腳／二手，唔報入主證並排。

3. Tanesini 2021（第17段＋註腳3）——核實層＝已並排公開 Precis／二次摘要（完整書未另下）。【框架截·肯定】(A) 智識謙遜不是單一德性，而是對優點的謙遜（modesty）與對弱點的接受（acceptance）之合；(B) 兩者建基於以求準確為動機的自我評估態度。【否定半句自標】(C) 「凡籠統承認都無用」＝作者自標不準確；(D) 姿態式「我很謙虛」若講不出具體弱點≠已對到＝作者推論。並排 Precis／摘要原句：\"intellectual humility is not one virtue but the aggregate of two virtues which are usually, but not always, to be found in the same people. The first virtue is modesty about intellectual strengths and achievements. The second is acceptance of intellectual weaknesses and failures\"／\"These virtues are underpinned by attitudes… driven by the motivation to be accurate in one's assessment of their epistemic worth\". 並排範圍＝A–B；C–D 自標分開。弱核實條目正文冇留未核硬百分比。

4. 對照第35註腳／第9段：十月二十六至三十一日欄劃清；本日唔重寫二十六、二十九日。同當日狐狸第9／第47註腳劃清一致，核過主題卡同當日狐狸，冇轉述錯週（【過關補充｜2026-10-11】第2條）。

【對【過關補充｜2026-10-18／10-19／10-20／10-21／10-22／10-26／10-27／10-28】執行】標題寫日期唔當已跟。Whitcomb 框架肯定主張各自有 PDF 原句；Cassam 框架有 SERC／書評引文；Tanesini 框架有 Precis 原句。否定半句「凡自述局限皆假／凡自認謙虛皆閉心／凡籠統承認皆廢／凡對到只能聽外力」自標超過原文，唔報入「各自有原句」。推論截正文歸因詞「這是我的推論」同 notes 推論層一致（【過關補充｜2026-10-20】）。唔把段意／改寫報「各自有原句」。

【數字／主語接龍｜10-07】本欄哲學論證為主，無把無標註模型表數字接龍。註腳收窄同正文一致（籠統口頭說≠owning；對到須落到可再挑戰判斷改動）。

【作者／總編】作者交稿寫入 prince.md；總編只做上述輕微用字／註腳核實層標註同刪未核句，冇改結構或代筆重寫。

【禁用語自搜｜本 notes】已搜本 notes：硬規則禁用語、企業腔例詞、無出處概括說法、極端全稱硬斷言當來源原句——冇中。完整詞「判斷」以外禁作動詞嘅單字用法亦冇中。（「並排」係過關補充技術詞。）

fox.title: 智識謙遜自我報告可勾高，答錯時調低信心卻可空白
fox.notes:
【首輪｜round=1｜2026-11-01｜pass｜兩欄已齊即審】總編輕微改：正文第15段刪來源正文／摘要未列之校準觀測總數「約二千六百九十二至二千七百四十二」（疑 N×3 推算且上界貼近研究二 914×3，卻寫喺研究一段），改為來源有寫之「three observations per participant」說法；分辨模型 Nobservations＝7,223–12,706 留低（摘要有原句）。結構同署名保留。跟 geo-gate 至【過關補充｜2026-10-28】。本 notes 寫「已跟」前已對禁止做法逐項交代。

【命題／呼應｜correspondence=match】跟當日小王子「籠統／姿態式承認『我有盲點』≠對到某處具體盲點憑證；要分開須講得出改了哪一處判斷、可否再被挑戰」。prince_ref 同小王子 title 一致。第9段收窄「籠統承認／對到盲點／擁有局限」同小王子第11段定義同義。兩欄「籠統承認／姿態式／擁有／對到盲點／判斷改動／可否再被挑戰／更順口」同一個意思（【過關補充｜2026-10-08】第1條），憑小王子第11、19段同狐狸第9、25–27段。狐狸第9段轉述惠特科姆 2017／卡薩姆 2019／塔內西尼 2021 同小王子第13–17段一致，冇週次／日期轉述錯。主例子另用 Costello et al. 2023 PsyArXiv；鄰近 Meagher et al. 2015；已寫明唔以小王子三源作唯一主例子。

【工具／做法／風險｜軟檢查】做法＝科斯特洛等 2023：智識謙遜自我報告量表＋知識題後設認知（校準＝估計表現對實際表現；分辨／resolution＝答對／答錯時信心是否分開調）。風險＝系統若只靠「我知自己有盲點／我很謙虛」勾選承認自我認識，而不設可指認標明（改了哪一處判斷、答錯時確定度有否調低、可否再被挑戰），承認可以停在更順口的全域謙遜說法（第35段）。報道取捨，唔對讀者落 style 禁用之抽象指令。「必須標明」係作者自標限度。

【立場段對主例子｜10-08】第27段立場「謙遜量表勾高／口頭承認有盲點≠已經對到某處盲點」同主例子「自我報告智識謙遜尺可單獨升高、答錯時調低信心／校準可空白或不相關」屬同一類量尺對照；已標「至少在科斯特洛等人所量到的校準與分辨尺上」。

【禁用語｜正文＋註腳】硬規則禁用語、企業腔例詞、style 列出嘅抽象指令、無出處「常見／一般都」——rg 掃過冇中。完整詞「判斷」以外禁作動詞嘅單字用法冇中。

【教材】冇有步驟練習教讀者。

【讓步／推論｜憑段｜10-05／10-06】第21段：量美國／英國線上成人在科學、疫情、假新聞與能力題上的估計表現與逐題信心；讀成日常「籠統承認我有盲點」或「尚未對到可再挑戰判斷盲點」＝推論；樣本非特定總體代表；未測情境化智識謙遜回憶量表。第33段四點可能錯有照顧結論：發現收窄喺「未對照校準／分辨的全域謙遜勾選本身不足以充當對到憑證」層。

【S6／過關補充逐項｜主證 Costello et al. 2023｜核實層＝已核本機 txt／docx（/workspace/factcheck-2026-11-01/costello-2023.txt；PsyArXiv／OSF）】
框架同操作數字分開列；自標推論分開計。否定半句全稱過度讀法——本文冇把「凡自述謙遜皆假」歸因來源；第21／33段自標＝作者限度，唔報入並排範圍（跟【過關補充｜2026-10-28】）。

(A) 框架：智識謙遜常被定義成認出知識與能力限度；研究卻多用自我報告量「自覺」謙遜，未必對上客觀後設認知；後設認知核成校準與分辨（resolution）——正文第13段。並排 txt：\"Intellectual humility (IH) is commonly defined metacognitively: as recognizing the limits of one's knowledge and abilities\"／\"commonly measured incommensurately with its theoretical basis (via self-reports questionnaires that reflect one's perceived, rather than objective, metacognitive abilities)\"／\"identifying two metacognitive statistical-behavioral properties… calibration and resolution\".

(B) 程序／研究一：Cloud Research／MTurk；篩後 N＝898；Leary 六題＋CIHS 二十二題四維；知識域含基礎科學、COVID-19、假新聞；每題 0–100 信心；每域再估答對幾題；GAMM——正文第15段。並排 txt：\"recruited through the Cloud Research academic crowdsourcing platform, which draws from high-performing Mechanical Turk workers\"／\"final sample size was 898\"／\"6-item Intellectual Humility Scale (Leary et al., 2017) and the 22-item Comprehensive Intellectual Humility Scale (CIHS; Krumrei-Mancuso & Rouse, 2016)\"／\"Independence of Intellect and Ego, Openness to Revising One's Viewpoint, Respect for Others' Viewpoints, and Lack of Intellectual Overconfidence\"／\"14 basic science statements… 14 COVID-19 statements… 16 banner images containing news headlines\"／\"sliding scale from 0… to 100\"／\"estimated the number of items they had answered correctly\"／\"yielding three observations per participant\".

(C) 操作數字｜校準——正文第17段：類似鄧寧－克魯格形態；基準模型解釋變異約 14.6%；五把 IH 尺無可靠非線性交互削弱該曲線；若干主效應反而指向同表現水平下估計更高（更偏高估）；Lack of Intellectual Overconfidence 例外（估計較低）。並排 txt：\"A pattern similar to the Dunning-Kruger effect was evident\"／\"explained variance… baseline model… was 14.6% in the mixed model\"／\"none of the non-linear interactions between actual performance and the IH… were statistically significant and/or yielded meaningfully improved model fit, suggesting that IH is not related to calibration\"／\"generally indicated that higher IH… associated with increased performance estimates at the same level of performance (i.e., overconfidence). The exception… CIHS Lack of Intellectual Overconfidence… lower estimates of their own performance\".

(D) 操作數字｜分辨——正文第19段：十至十二組 IH 交互多數顯著但效果小，ΔR² 約 .001–.003；多數 IH 尺連答對時信心升高、與答錯時信心無顯著關聯（wise confidence）；唯 Lack of Intellectual Overconfidence 與答錯時信心下降相關；COVID-19：每升一單位答錯信心約 −2.17（95% CI −3.66 至 −0.68）、答對約 +0.94；思考風格在分辨上往往更穩。並排 txt：\"a significant interaction effect was present for 10 of the 12 models. Effect sizes were generally small, with ΔR² ranging from .001 to .003\"／\"for all IH variables—except CIHS Lack of Intellectual Overconfidence—IH was significantly associated with increased confidence in correct answers but was not significantly associated with confidence in incorrect answers… consistent with a wise confidence dynamic\"／\"effect of a 1 unit increase in CIHS Lack of Intellectual Overconfidence on confidence for incorrect COVID-19 answers… was -2.17 percentage points (95% CI [-3.66, -0.68]\"／\"on confidence for correct COVID-19 answers was +0.94 percentage points\"／\"the 4-CTSQ dimensions outperformed IH measures in predicting resolution\"／摘要層 \"Nobservations per model = 7,223-12,706\".

(E) 研究二——正文第21段：Prolific；篩後 N＝914；預註冊覆核；校準上 IH 仍未可靠削弱鄧寧－克魯格式脫節；分辨上多數仍主要連答對時信心；Lack of Intellectual Overconfidence 再次較近答錯時調低信心；準確自我報告 IH 可能已要求後設認知準確度——缺乏者會系統高報謙遜；未測情境化量表；樣本非特定總體代表。並排 txt：\"recruited through the Prolific Academic crowdsourcing platform\"／\"final sample size was 914\"／\"corroborate in a pre-registered replication\"／\"no significant interaction between any IH measure and calibration\"／\"Four of the five IH dimensions were reliably associated with increased confidence when participants answered a question correctly but accounted for vanishingly little variance for confidence in incorrect answers\"／\"Accurately self-reporting about one's IH… may require metacognitive accuracy… people lacking accurate metacognitive access will systematically overreport their degree of IH\"／\"we did not evaluate the performance of ‘contextualized’ measures of IH\"／\"MTurk and Prolific workers are not representative of any specified population\".

(F) 鄰近 Meagher et al. 2015——正文第23段：自我報告 IH 與自我抬高正相關，關係共識評分則否。核實層＝已核本機 PDF／txt。並排：\"Self-reported IH in both studies was positively associated with self-enhancement… whereas relational IH was not\". 鄰近不作唯一主證；作者已標。
